instruction: Create one Part Design body. Create a circular base disk centered on the global Z axis with radius 26 mm and height 5 mm, spanning Z = 0 to 5. Create one raised cylindrical boss on the top face with radius 3 mm and height 6 mm, axis along global Z, centered at (16, 0) and spanning Z = 5 to 11. Use Part Design Polar Pattern around the global Z axis through the origin to create 8 total boss occurrences evenly spaced through 360 degrees, so the boss centers lie on a 16 mm radius circle at 45 degree intervals. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
